claims.text: The rider's claim is narrow and precise: a $2.00 ERP charge for the 'AYE Alexandra Rd gantry' appears on a trip whose optimal route carries zero ERP. The fare breakdown itself records optimal_route_erp_sgd of 0.00 and an off_optimal_route_total of $2.00, so the entire contested amount is a pass-through line the rider never should have borne on the optimal route.

The gantry the rider was billed for is not on the optimal route. The fare breakdown's own erp_lines entry marks 'AYE Alexandra Rd gantry' with on_optimal_route = false, and the trip record's optimal_route_erp_sgd is 0.00. A gantry the optimal route does not use cannot be a charge the rider owes for the optimal trip.

The GPS trace never passes the gantry. The nearest fix to the AYE Alexandra Rd gantry coordinates is 6,130.08 m away, at index 55, timestamped 2026-09-08T12:48:05+08:00 — more than six kilometres from the gantry the rider was charged for. Under POL-RD-09(4) a charge line for a gantry the trace never passes is a billing-integrity failure refundable in full, and the 250 m crossing test is plainly not met.

The trace is clean and unimpaired for policy purposes: 108 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, zero gaps, max_gap_sec of 0.0, and no straight-line jump over 500 m. POL-RD-07(a) to (c) are not engaged, so the trace may be relied on directly and no independent corroboration is required to establish the billing-integrity defect.

The driver's only answer is that 'the ERP is charged by the system.' That is an assertion of an external cause with no traffic_advisory cited and no advisory on file — the bundle's traffic advisory artifact is MISSING with weight 0.0. Under POL-RD-13 the assertion is tested against the traffic_advisory and nothing else; with no advisory covering the trip window, POL-RD-03 is unavailable and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08.

The rider's own profile does not weaken the claim: deviation_claims_60d is 0 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, so the POL-RD-08 corroboration uplift for a serial claimant (4 or more claims with 1 or fewer substantiated) is not triggered and the trace alone suffices.

The rider's claim is not a route-deviation claim at all — it is a billing-integrity claim about a single $2.00 line. The trace shows a 0.65 km excess over the 13.0 km optimal, which is 5.00% and below both the 20% and 0.8 km POL-RD-01 establishment tests, so no deviation is established and the distance and time charges stand. But POL-RD-09(4) is expressly available 'whether or not a deviation exists', and it is the clause that governs this $2.00 line.

The rider filed this dispute and the fare breakdown shows payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.0. The $2.00 is still in the platform's hands and the rider is still carrying it. A ruling that refunds the phantom gantry line leaves the rider not carrying the disputed charge, which is the rider win this record supports.

The optimal route for this trip carried zero ERP (optimal_route_erp_sgd = 0.0), so the entire SGD 2.00 is an off-optimal-route pass-through charge. Under POL-RD-09(4) a charge line for a gantry the trace never passes is a billing-integrity failure refundable in full as a standalone correction, available whether or not a deviation exists.

The driver's own GPS trace never comes near the charged gantry. The nearest fix to the AYE Alexandra Rd gantry is 6130.08 m away (fix index 55, timestamp 2026-09-08T12:48:05+08:00), and the derived block records gap_brackets_closest_approach = false, meaning no pair of consecutive fixes brackets the gantry. Under POL-RD-09 a gantry is matched to the trace by treating any fix within 250 m of the gantry as a crossing; 6130 m is more than twenty times that radius, so the trace does not place the vehicle at this gantry at all. The SGD 2.00 line is therefore a phantom charge and is refunded in full under POL-RD-09(4).

The trace is clean and unimpaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: 108 fixes at a 10.0 s sample interval, 100.0% coverage, zero gaps and a maximum gap of 0.0 s, so none of limbs (a) to (c) fires. The admissibility pre-pass likewise tags EV-GPS-02815 COMPLETE with weight_multiplier 1.0 and no issue codes. The gantry-proximity finding therefore rests on a full-weight artifact and needs no independent corroboration under POL-RD-07(ii).

The driver's only answer to the rider's claim is the bare assertion that 'The ERP is charged by the system.' That is an assertion that cites no evidence ID and points to no clause, and under POL-RD-08 an assertion from either side that cites no evidence ID carries no weight and is discarded. It does not discharge the driver's burden of pointing to a specific artifact and a specific clause, and it does not make the SGD 2.00 line chargeable.

The driver cannot fall back on an external traffic cause. The bundle holds no traffic_advisory covering this trip window: EV-ADVIS-02815-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and the blocking issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, its note recording that no advisory covers the Northpoint City corridor in this window. Under POL-RD-13 the comparison POL-RD-03 requires cannot be run on the record, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and any traffic excuse carries no weight under POL-RD-08. The driver has in any event named no advisory identifier, so the absence is a gap in the bundle rather than an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact.

The distance and time lines are not in issue on this record and the driver should not be penalised on them. The trace distance is 13.65 km against an optimal of 13.0 km, an excess of 0.65 km or 5.00%, which fails both POL-RD-01 establishment tests (greater than 20% of optimal AND greater than 0.8 km absolute). The derived deviation block itself records status 'no deviation'. No POL-RD-02 recomputation runs, and the rider's recovery is confined to the ERP pass-through correction under POL-RD-09.

The rider's profile does not weaken this claim and must not be used to deny it. rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, so the POL-RD-08 corroboration uplift for a serial claimant is not engaged at all. The rider's prior_no_show_flags and prior_disputes_upheld are lifetime counters and context only under POL-GEN-01; they may not ground any finding about this trip.

The driver's profile likewise cannot rescue the charge. driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 and completed_trips_90d is 388, so no repeat-deviation pattern is established under POL-RD-06 and no uplift or referral follows from it. The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is a near-synonym trap and is not the trailing-90-day figure POL-RD-06 names; under POL-GEN-01 it is context only and may not be substituted.

The rider's claim is supported by the fare ledger itself, which is the artifact that carries the disputed line. EV-FARE-02815 is COMPLETE with weight_multiplier 1.0, its ledger lines reconcile to total_charged, and it records payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.0. The SGD 2.00 has been collected and nothing has been returned, so the standalone correction under POL-RD-09(4) is live and the present state does not already make the rider whole.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver.

Rider's claim: the SGD 2.00 'AYE Alexandra Rd gantry' ERP line on trip TRP-02815 (Northpoint City to Blk 503 Bishan St 11, 8 Sep 2026) is a charge for a road the trip never used.

What the record shows. The fare breakdown EV-FARE-02815 itemises exactly one ERP line, 'AYE Alexandra Rd gantry', SGD 2.00, and marks it on_optimal_route = false; the trip record EV-TRIP-02815 sets the optimal-route ERP at SGD 0.00. The GPS trace EV-GPS-02815 is complete and clean (108 fixes, 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps, max gap 0.0 s), and its nearest approach to the gantry coordinates is 6,130.08 m (fix index 55 at 12:48:05), with no pair of bracketing fixes. POL-RD-09 matches a gantry to the trace by treating a fix within 250 m as a crossing; 6,130 m is more than twenty times that radius, so the trace never passes this gantry. Under POL-RD-09(4) the SGD 2.00 line is a billing-integrity failure and is refunded in full as a standalone correction — a remedy that limb makes available whether or not any route deviation exists. The driver's reply that 'the ERP is charged by the system' cites no artifact and no clause and carries no weight under POL-RD-08; it does not make the line chargeable.

Route deviation. On the same figures the trace distance is 13.65 km against the booked optimal of 13.0 km, an excess of 0.65 km or 5.0%. That fails both POL-RD-01 establishment tests (more than 20% and more than 0.8 km), so no deviation is established, the derived deviation status 'no deviation' stands, and no POL-RD-02 recomputation runs. The distance and time charges within the SGD 21.86 total charged stand as billed.

Profiles, advisory and burden. Neither profile changes the outcome. The only citable counters are rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d / _substantiated (0 / 0, so POL-RD-08's serial-claimant corroboration rule is not engaged) and driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d / completed_trips_90d (0 / 388, so no POL-RD-06 pattern); the lifetime counters prior_no_show_flags, prior_disputes_upheld and prior_deviation_flags are context only under POL-GEN-01 and were not used as a ground of decision. EV-ADVIS-02815-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 and no traffic advisory covers this trip window; because the driver cited no advisory, the absence is a gap in the bundle rather than an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, and POL-RD-13 keeps the case out of POL-RD-10(5). No POL-RD-10 escalation trigger fires.

Order and execution. Of the SGD 4.00 contested, SGD 2.00 is returned: PARTIAL_REFUND. No driver compensation is due — the distance billed (13.7 km) is not less than the trace records (13.65 km), so the POL-RD-04 unbilled-distance limb does not run. The monetary effect (SGD 2.00) is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00 and executes automatically, subject to appeal under POL-GEN-04. Confidence 0.9; the finding rests on EV-GPS-02815 and EV-FARE-02815, both at weight 1.0, and no impaired artifact carries it.

ruling.explanation:
Rider, you are right about the ERP line and part of what you were charged comes back; Driver, the rest of the fare stands. This ruling was made without human review and either party may appeal it under POL-GEN-04.

What the trip shows. EV-TRIP-02815, EV-GPS-02815 and EV-FARE-02815 all carry trip TRP-02815 and their pickup/start times agree, so the artifacts describe the same trip (POL-RD-08(a)). The trace is clean: 108 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage and no gaps, so it is NOT impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c) and may be relied on directly. The trace distance is 13.65 km against a booked optimal of 13.00 km, an excess of 0.65 km or 5.00%. That fails both POL-RD-01 establishment tests (more than 20% of optimal AND more than 0.80 km absolute), so no route deviation is established, the distance and time charges stand, and no POL-RD-02 recomputation runs. That answers both advocates' POL-RD-01 claims.

The ERP line. The fare charged 21.86 SGD in total, of which the single ERP line is 2.00 SGD for the 'AYE Alexandra Rd gantry'; the optimal route carries 0.00 ERP (optimal_route_erp_sgd = 0.0) and the off-optimal-route total is 2.00 SGD. The gantry's own coordinates (1.366147, 103.754636) are tested against the trace under POL-RD-09: the nearest fix is 6,130.08 m away (index 55, 2026-09-08T12:48:05+08:00) and no pair of consecutive fixes brackets the gantry. The 250 m crossing test is nowhere near met, so the trace does not place the vehicle at this gantry at all. Under POL-RD-09(4) a charge line for a gantry the trace never passes is a billing-integrity failure: the 2.00 SGD is refunded in full as a standalone correction, available whether or not a deviation exists. The route distance being only 5.00% over optimal does not defeat this, because POL-RD-09(4) does not depend on a deviation. This is a referral under POL-RD-09(4), not an escalation: POL-RD-10(8) expressly does not fire where the only unmatched line is one refunded under that limb, and no POL-RD-10 trigger otherwise applies (identifiers match; the trace is unimpaired; no timestamp conflicts; confidence is above 0.70).

To both parties: this trip's distance and time charges stand, and one fare line is returned.

Lifetime counters (prior_deviation_flags, prior_no_show_flags, prior_disputes_upheld) and all other profile fields are context only under POL-GEN-01 and were not used.
